The American Cancer Society does not endorse any product or service.

ashampooblackandwhite_issue9.description_text: Ashampoo BLACK & WHITE #9 transforms color photos into expressive black-and-white images and provides 200 professionally optimized presets in 14 categories as well as 228 image filters in Expert Mode. The software combines fast results with extensive options for individual customization and supports 1,382 RAW formats from various camera manufacturers. Five additional color spaces expand black-and-white conversion and enable nuanced control over brightness, contrast, and overall image impact. AI-powered depth calculation automatically creates precise depth maps and provides the foundation for spatial effects, blurs, and masking. New preset categories for Spatial Depth and 3D Effects, 24 new presets, 15 new general effects, and 24 new 3D effects further expand the creative possibilities. AI masking of foreground and background, Selective Drawing, additional layer blending modes, and new mask-smoothing tools support targeted editing of individual image areas. The watermark module integrates custom logos or text, while two-stage supersampling improves image quality. Sensor defect correction, improved focus peaking, flexible scaling options, and quick saving in JPEG format further enhance the workflow.

ashampoopanorama_issue1.description_text: Ashampoo PANORAMA #1 is an easy-to-use panorama software for creating high-quality panoramas from up to 15 photos. The application automatically combines images into seamless panoramas and supports classic single-row shots as well as multi-row and vertical panoramas. Three geometric projections—spherical, cylindrical, and planar—enable realistic representations of landscapes and architecture. Intelligent algorithms provide automatic horizon correction and remove incomplete image edges through automatic cropping, resulting in a clean and properly aligned base image. For further optimization, exposure and RAW adjustments are available in three levels to balance brightness and color differences between individual photos before stitching. For precise control, the software includes tools such as a magnifier and comparison view. The integrated cropping window supports accurate composition with guide lines and more than 60 aspect ratio presets. The feature set is completed by a selective editing module with effect, color filter, colorization, and compositing masks for targeted image adjustments.

ashampoophotoorganizerpro26.description_text: Ashampoo Photo Organizer Pro is a powerful photo management tool. It lets you quickly sort photos, remove duplicates, and manage metadata. With automatic grouping, it helps you filter out poor-quality images and find what you need fast. It's compatible with Windows, macOS, and Android, and works with cloud services like OneDrive and Dropbox. The software creates smart albums based on keywords, ratings, or locations, and offers ultra-fast searches by criteria like location, rating, or camera properties. One standout feature is its ability to automatically select the best photos based on capture data and quality, making it easier to create photo books. It also provides quality ratings to help you find the sharpest photo in a series and features for easy sorting and duplicate removal. Additionally, it can automatically rename files according to a naming pattern and display geolocations on a map. The software supports major photo formats like JPG, PNG, WebP, and various RAW formats (e.g., Canon CR2, Nikon NEF) and allows for lossless rotation or mirroring of images. The theater mode offers a comfortable full-screen view. Ashampoo Photo Organizer Pro can be used on all devices, enabling cross-platform photo management. Photos are displayed instantly without the need for import so files stay safely in their original storage locations.

ashampoofaceblur.description_text: In today's digital world, where data privacy and confidentiality are gaining increased importance, Ashampoo Face Blur offers a user-friendly tool to preserve anonymity in images. The software automatically detects faces and, upon request, obscures them, effectively protecting the privacy of family members, friends, and colleagues. Ashampoo Face Blur is easy to use and provides quick results. Thanks to its intuitive user interface, even those with no prior experience in image editing can use the tool confidently. With just one click, users can choose between a blur effect, classic pixelation, or an emoticon to anonymize faces. This simple feature saves valuable time, making the tool indispensable for anyone who regularly edits and publishes images. Ashampoo Face Blur's functionality is especially useful in sensitive environments, such as schools and public events, where identity protection is crucial. The tool also helps maintain anonymity while creating professional, privacy-compliant images when processing company photos or sharing pictures of kids on social media.

ashampoosnappro26.description_text:
The new Ashampoo Snap Pro 26 – with Live Edit for a new way to create screenshots

With Ashampoo Snap Pro 26, creating screenshots and videos is easier than ever! Everything that appears on your screen can be captured in seconds. In the image editor, you can edit, annotate, save, and share your captures instantly. New: With Live Edit, you can even mark content directly on your Desktop before the screenshot is taken. Snap Pro 26 also enhances your screenshots with graphical elements such as automatic numbering, comments, stickers, and more. Whether you're working from home, explaining something quickly, or creating detailed tutorials, Snap Pro 26 lets you get the job done faster.

Direct editing with text, highlighting, numbering, blur tools and a handy screenshot library Ideal for instructions, tutorials and documentation with flexible export as PNG, JPG, PDF and cloud upload

Live Edit–Mark directly on your desktop

Live Edit places a transparent layer like a sheet of glass over your screen. On this layer, you can draw arrows, add text, or highlight areas directly on top of the content you want to explain. Unlike traditional screenshot tools, your screen does not freeze during this process. You can switch back to your Desktop at any time to move windows, adjust content, or let a video continue playing, and then continue working on your annotations. This way, the final screenshot evolves step by step without having to restart the process.

Prepare and create screenshots faster

With Live Edit, multiple screenshots can be prepared and created within a single workflow. Annotations remain visible while you continue working on your Desktop and can be adjusted at any time. Especially with large workspaces or multi-monitor setups, Live Edit provides plenty of screen estate to organize content clearly. The final screenshot is then created directly from the Live Edit view–What you see is always what you get!

Better performance, stability and resource efficiency

The new Ashampoo Snap is built on a fully modernized technical foundation: The program starts faster, responds more quickly, and operates more smoothly overall. At the same time, memory usage and background process activity has been significantly reduced so Snap remains responsive and stable even during longer sessions. This new foundation improves everyday performance while also preparing Snap for future enhancements and new features.

Enhanced workflow and modernized interface

We have also improved many details for everyday work with Snap. The image editor's toolbar is smarter and supports your workflow even better. The properties bar has been restructured to provide a clearer and more consistent user experience. The updated color scheme improves readability and makes longer working sessions less strainful. With Quick Scroll, you also get a smart thumbnail preview that automatically appears when needed and helps you navigate large captures more easily.

Live Edit changes the way screenshots are created. Comments and annotations are placed directly on the Desktop while the screen remains active. This makes explaining content much faster and more flexible.

More practical improvements

Many already useful features have been further refined: Cliparts now support drag & drop and image imports are more convenient, tools like the arrow tool offer better precision, and additional output formats are available for emailing images. The print dialog has also been updated and now supports margin settings in centimeters. In addition, video exports now support a quality settings to save storage space or speed up exports.

Smart desktop capturing and sharing

Once active, Snap's magic eye auto-detects elements below your mouse pointer (browser windows, program menus, images, etc.) and offers instant 1-click capturing with pixel precision. But it doesn't stop there: Snap can also capture custom rectangular or freehand regions and even supports scrolling content! Naturally, the program supports all possible kinds of sharing options, including email and Ashampoo Web!

Optical character recognition (OCR) for your screenshots

As of now, Snap no longer recognizes just 7 but over 180 languages! Our new text recognition utilizes Windows' own language packs and produces better results faster. Chances are you won't be needing over 180 languages straight away so, in the interest of simplicity, we've limited the number of initially available languages to the system languages currently installed on your machine. You can easily add additional languages via the "Add language" menu item.

Fast and easy video cutting

Not every video recording is an instant success. Ads, extra steps or pauses are a frequent bother. The same applies to screen captures. Keep the important bits and get rid of the rest with Ashampoo Snap! Remove ads, glitches or superfluous scenes or split your video into individual episodes. It doesn't matter whether you're casually pointing and capturing, creating an extensive webinar or producing a high-quality presentation: With Ashampoo Snap, every video capture comes out a success!

Create videos for any purpose

Creating instructional videos or documentaries is a breeze with Ashampoo Snap. Recordings are live-annotable with texts, drawings and voice narration. Clear things up with visualized mouse clicks and key strokes and add watermarks to protect your intellectual property. Take it to the next level and add live feeds from your webcam in a single click. Here's your ticket to create engaging tutorials, prepare instructive webinars and to point the way to the things that matter most to you–literally!

Perfect for different screen resolutions and multi-display environments

Ashampoo Snap fully supports multi-display setups, even with different resolution and DPI combinations, e.g. mixed Full HD and 4K environments. Each display is captured at its individual resolution for maximum crispness and results are instantly editable. And once you're in the editor, it's smooth sailing for beginners and professionals alike!

Create GIFs from any video

What would the internet be without those charming GIF animations? But GIFs can also be used in tutorials or demonstrations to great effect. Ashampoo Snap can turn any video segment into GIFs. Just set the start and end positions, fire up the built-in converter and you're done!

More than a snipping tool: extensive comfort features

Ashampoo Snap does most of the heavy lifting for you. Automatic numbering or time-delayed captures will help you make the most of your shots. Freely annotate your captures with texts and drawings or use flood fills. Put the spotlight on individual portions, blur sensitive data and use the highlighter to direct attention in style!

Capture desktop contents and save videos or images from the internet

The internet is brimming with fascinating images, texts and videos. Ashampoo Snap makes it easy to capture what you like! Save image and videos and edit them on the fly and to your liking! Anything you see on your screen, or hear through your sound card, Snap can capture!

ashampoosharpenvideo_issue3.description_text: With Ashampoo SHARPEN Video #3, videos can be sharpened quickly and efficiently for stunning image quality. Footage is often slightly out of focus or lacks contrast—this is where the powerful sharpening technology comes in. Thanks to intelligent blur analysis, each frame is individually optimized for crystal-clear results. The advanced sharpening engine, combined with GPU acceleration, ensures even faster processing, handling 4K and 8K videos with ease. In addition to sharpening, the software includes haze and fog correction, perfect for challenging lighting conditions—a must-have feature also for drone footage. Various blur reduction modes allow precise adjustments, from balanced enhancement to professional sharpness levels. Additionally, powerful tools like a RAW module enable easy post-processing, allowing users to fine-tune exposure, colors, and even horizon alignment effortlessly. With Ashampoo SHARPEN Video #3, every video receives a professional touch—fast, easy, and without the need for complex software.

ashampoophotorecovery3.description_text: Ashampoo Photo Recovery 3 reliably restores deleted or damaged photos from hard drives, USB sticks, memory cards, and smartphones. Even if a device has been formatted or is no longer recognized, the software offers powerful recovery capabilities. It can even detect and recover images embedded in PDF or Office documents. The application supports all common image formats as well as RAW files from digital cameras. A built-in preview function shows which images can be recovered during the scan process. Filters based on file format, image size, or resolution help narrow down results, especially when scanning large volumes of data. Ashampoo Photo Recovery 3 also performs well on damaged file systems, going far beyond basic undelete tools by enabling recovery from formatted or corrupted drives. This makes it suitable not only for accidental deletions but also for more complex data loss scenarios. New in version 3: The user interface has been completely redesigned with a sleek, modern look, updated menus, and animated progress indicators. JPG and PNG files now load up to 50% faster, and support for metadata such as EXIF and XMP has been improved. The latest RAW formats—like those used by Canon, Nikon, and DNG-based cameras—are better supported. Numerous stability improvements and updated internal components (e.g., codecs and libraries) provide an even more reliable photo recovery experience.

ashampoozoom_issue3.description_text: Ashampoo ZOOM #3 offers a powerful solution for lossless image upscaling—perfect for printing, presentations, and creative projects. Thanks to AI-powered SSSP technology (Super Symmetric Smart Patches), photos can be enlarged by up to 20,000% without visible artifacts or loss of detail. The intelligent detail synthesis accurately reconstructs microstructures, while automatic blur correction ensures crisp contours. A standout feature is the STM (Short Term Memory) technology, which enables fast processing even for large image files. Real-time assistants help balance processing time and quality for optimal results. Whether you're working with single images or large photo sets, the integrated batch processing feature streamlines your workflow. ZOOM #3 supports over 1,300 camera RAW formats and includes a dedicated RAW module for professional work. Up to 500 common sensor defects—like spots or scratches—are detected and removed automatically. You can even add your integrate training images into the AI system for personalized optimization. The user interface is clean, scalable, and optimized for high-resolution displays (HD/4K). Extensive presets,dedicated printing tools, a zoom magnifier, and a side-by-side comparison view provide comfortable handling and full control during scaling.

ashampoohdr_issue11.description_text: Ashampoo HDR #11 creates breathtaking HDR images with maximum dynamic range, perfectly balancing light and shadow for natural, lifelike results. The software combines cutting-edge HDR technology with artificial intelligence to deliver precise, detailed reproductions even of complex scenes. Photos taken at different exposure levels are automatically merged into realistic, high-contrast images that showcase the full visual potential of each shot. In version 11, the HDR engine has been completely redesigned. All HDR styles have been reworked and enhanced with newly trained neural networks, providing noticeably greater depth, balance, and realism. Two brand-new styles – “Monochrome” and “Monochrome Depth” – expand creative possibilities, while additional user-defined styles allow for custom looks. The improved ghosting correction feature removes motion artifacts with higher accuracy, and the contour-sensitive selective painting tool allows for precise manual adjustments. The Expert Mode introduces new 3D effects and AI-powered filters, along with a real-time color module, super-sampling for perfectly smooth edges, and virtual micro-details and film grain for added realism. The new watermark module makes it easy to embed transparent logos directly into your images. With an updated interface, twice the startup speed, and up to 50% faster image processing, Ashampoo HDR #11 delivers a smooth, professional editing experience that combines power, precision, and creativity.

ashampooanalog_issue5.description_text:
ANALOG #5 is an advanced image editing program that specialises in creating professional image effects with a focus on emulating old image styles. It offers a wide range of tools and functions that help turn your digital photos into works of art.

With manually optimised templates (presets) and AI-controlled effects based on twelve categories, the program optimises the rapid application of classic old image effects (analogue looks) on your images. The intuitive user interface and varied collection of 160 filters, including 19 new AI filters in 8 categories such as noise suppression, sharpening, colour adjustment and artistic effects, provide extensive editing options for perfecting every detail of your photo.

ashampoofocus_issue6.description_text: FOCUS #6 is an advanced image editing program that is ideal for macro photography. It enables the creation of a sharp image from a series of photos with varying depths of sharpness. This function is particularly useful in situations where the depth of field of the camera is insufficient for displaying the whole object with the requisite sharpness in close-up shots.

ashampoodenoise_issue6.description_text: Poor lighting conditions or fast movements often cause distracting image noise—even with the best camera. Ashampoo DENOISE #6 precisely analyzes each shot and removes noise selectively without blurring important details. With the latest AI technology, you can now choose from four specialized AI models, each designed for different noise reduction tasks—preserving fine details or optimizing color accuracy. The new “Replace Image” function in the current project adds more flexibility, while the customizable interface in the Finalize and Expert sections allows for intuitive control and tailored adjustments. This ensures you get the best out of every shot.

ashampoozoomvideo_issue3.description_text: Ashampoo ZOOM Video #3 is a software solution for video upscaling and quality adjustment with support for resolutions up to 4K UHD. The application combines deep learning technology with the proprietary SSSP method to perform pixel-precise analysis of video material. Image content is evaluated in a structured manner, details are reconstructed, and textures are selectively refined to achieve a clear and consistent visual result. The integrated “Intelligent Details” method is designed to reconstruct fine microstructures during the upscaling process. Organic image details are generated without artificially altering the original material. Multiple quality levels allow precise control over detail rendering, while multi-level gamma aliasing ensures smooth contours and natural edges. ZOOM Video #3 supports modern video codecs such as AV1, AV1 (GPU), and VP9, each offering nine quality levels for adjusting output quality and file size. Additional features include video trimming, frame rate adjustment, and flexible export options for different use cases. Individual video frames can be saved or printed as images. An AI-assisted, configurable short-term memory with integrated scene change detection supports the upscaling process and enables structured processing of larger video collections. This makes Ashampoo ZOOM Video #3 well suited for preparing archival footage, older recordings, and low-resolution videos for modern displays.

ashampoofoto3d_issue1.description_text: Ashampoo Photo 3D #1 is innovative photo editing software that uses modern AI technology to add realistic spatial depth to images. When opening a photo, the software automatically detects foreground, background, and intermediate areas, generating a depth map that serves as the foundation for numerous effects. Spatial lighting makes it possible to place targeted light accents, such as warm tones in the foreground or cool highlights in the background. A flash simulation with freely selectable position automatically calculates shadows and light transitions. Atmospheric features such as haze simulation, colored fog, or targeted haze reduction give photos a distinctive mood. Creative users can create stereoscopic 3D anaglyph images for red-cyan glasses, simulate camera bokeh, apply tilt-shift effects, or add color gradients along the depth axis. Forty built-in presets provide quick results, while a watermark module automatically integrates transparent logos or text. Additional options include selective lighting and coloring of specific depth areas, adjusting perspective zoom, and simulating diffuse light sources and directional light beams. Ashampoo Photo 3D #1 combines ease of use with a wide range of professional effects, transforming ordinary shots into images with depth, atmosphere, and creative impact.

ashampoocolor_issue9.description_text: Ashampoo COLOR #9 is a photo editing program for adjusting colors, image looks and spatial effects. The software provides 221 image presets, including 28 new presets, as well as 281 filters in expert mode. AI-powered depth mapping analyzes foreground, background and spatial areas of an image, enabling depth and 3D effects based on the resulting depth information. Selective drawing and AI masking allow individual image areas to be edited precisely. Additional features include 24 new 3D effects, 15 general effects, more than 30 accelerated filters, two levels of supersampling, focus peaking and sensor defect correction. A watermark module allows custom logos or signatures to be added to images. The software supports 1,382 RAW formats. The AI functions run locally on the computer, so images do not need to be uploaded to the cloud for processing.

ashampoobackgroundremover2.description_text: Ashampoo Background Remover 2 lets you automatically cut out people and objects from photos with ease. The AI reliably detects main subjects—including subtle details like hair. Manual post-processing tools help you fine-tune results by adding or removing specific areas. Extracted objects can be saved, exported to other applications, or combined with new backgrounds. The software includes visual filters like black & white, sepia, and noir, along with transparency controls to help match foreground and background perfectly. Version 2 features AI upscaling that can enlarge extracted elements up to four times their original size without visible quality loss—perfect for use in high-resolution projects. The selection frame tool lets you pinpoint the right subjects in complex scenes with multiple detected objects, minimizing editing time. New background filters offer creative effects and/or clear separation between subject and background, and can be adjusted using a precision transparency slider. All AI-powered features—both for object removal and upscaling—run entirely offline. No data is sent to external servers, ensuring your privacy is fully protected.

ashampoosharpen_issue6.description_text:
Ashampoo SHARPEN #6 is software designed to improve blurry or shaky photos. Each image is analyzed individually, and sharpening is automatically adapted to the subject and type of blur. This makes contours clearer, fine structures more visible, and smooth areas such as skies or skin tones protected from oversharpening. The result is a balanced and natural image.

The program provides two operation modes. Compact Mode is ideal for quick results with minimal effort, while Pro Mode gives full access to all parameters for precise adjustments. Photos can also be enhanced with watermarks or logos, offering both protection and personalization. For image refinement, Ashampoo SHARPEN #6 includes several tools. Enhanced super-sampling ensures clean contours, virtual micro-details and adjustable grain add depth to images, and a contour-sensitive brush allows selective adjustments. AI algorithms assist in these tasks to deliver consistent results. Thanks to modern AI technologies, the software also works highly efficiently, enabling noticeably faster processing. This makes it possible to handle even large photo collections quickly and reliably, producing images with clarity, detail, and brilliance.
